# Horror Echos

**Horror Echos** is a modpack with many different horror mods, including very popular ones such as the [Cave Dweller](https://modrinth.com/mod/cave-dweller-evolved).

This modpack includes animations and other 3D texture, realistic sounds, ambient sounds and elytra physics as well.

_Very spooky 🎃!_
